name: Jellyfin
blurb: Stream your own movies and shows to your TV, phone and browser.

folder.label: Folder with your movies and shows

next: Open it, create your account, and add the /media folder as a library.

name: Navidrome
blurb: Your music collection, playable from any browser or music app.
next: Open it and create the admin account. It scans /music on its own.

name: Audiobookshelf
blurb: Audiobooks and podcasts, with the phone app keeping your place.
next: Open it, create the root user, and add /audiobooks as a library.

name: AdGuard Home
blurb: Blocks ads and trackers for every device on your Wi-Fi.
note: It needs port 53. On Ubuntu that port is often taken by the system's own DNS service, and install fails if so.
next: Open it and finish setup. Then set your router's DNS server to this machine's address so every device uses it.

name: Vaultwarden
blurb: Password manager that works with the Bitwarden apps and browser extensions.
note: Browsers only let you log in over HTTPS. Plan to put it behind HTTPS (Tailscale Serve is the easiest way) before you rely on it.
next: Open it over HTTPS and create your account.

name: Mealie
blurb: Save recipes from any website and plan the week's meals.
next: Open it and log in with changeme@example.com / MyPassword, then change both.

name: Uptime Kuma
blurb: Checks your sites and apps every minute and tells you when one goes down.
next: Open it, create an account, and add the first thing to watch.

name: Open WebUI with Ollama
blurb: A ChatGPT-style chat page running models on your own machine.
note: The download is several GB, so install can take a few minutes. On a Mac, Docker can't use the GPU, so models run slowly there.
next: Open it, create the admin account, then pick a model to download in Settings.

name: Ollama
blurb: Runs open models and gives your tools an API to use them.
note: On a Mac, Docker can't use the GPU. The Ollama Mac app from ollama.com is much faster there.
next: Point your tools at port 11434. To get a model, run: docker exec ollama ollama pull llama3.2
